title: Loneliness and desire for thinness explain sex differences in adolescent internalizing problems
title_zh: 孤独与追求苗条解释青少年内化问题的性别差异
abstract: Girls are at higher risk of internalizing problems than boys. This disparity has widened in recent decades, but the underlying mechanisms remain understudied. Here we analysed data from 3,171 adolescents (46.9% girls) within the Tokyo Teen Cohort, assessed at ages 12, 14 and 16 years. At age 16, girls showed higher prevalence of internalizing problems than boys: depressive symptoms (15.9% versus 8.2%) and suicidal ideation (29.8% versus 18.1%). Coproduction with young people suggested loneliness and desire for thinness as candidate pathways. Using the mediational g-formula, we estimated that the effect through these factors at age 14 relative to the total effect of female sex was 34.7% for depressive symptoms and 46.3% for suicidal ideation at age 16. These findings suggest that social intermediates may contribute to the higher prevalence of internalizing problems among girls in this cohort, highlighting potential targets for interventions and policies informed by young people. Girls tend to show higher rates of depression and suicidal ideation than boys. This work suggests that loneliness and pressure to be thin explain much of this gap, suggesting that social factors are key targets for youth-focused support, policy and intervention.
abstract_zh: 女孩比男孩更容易出现内化问题。这种差异在近几十年扩大，但其潜在机制尚未得到充分研究。在此，我们分析了东京青少年队列中3,171名青少年的数据（46.9%为女孩），这些青少年在12、14和16岁时进行了评估。16岁时，女孩相比男孩表现出更高的内化问题患病率：抑郁症状（15.9%对8.2%）和自杀念头（29.8%对18.1%）。与青少年合作提出了孤独和追求苗条作为候选途径。使用中介g-公式，我们估计这些因素在14岁时相对于女性性别的总效应，在16岁时对抑郁症状的中介效应占34.7%，对自杀念头的中介效应占46.3%。这些发现表明，社会中介因素可能有助于女孩在该队列中内化问题的更高患病率，突出了基于青少年视角的干预和政策的潜在目标。女孩相比男孩表现出更高的抑郁和自杀念头率。这项研究表明，孤独和苗条的压力解释了很大一部分差距，表明社会因素是青少年支持、政策和干预的关键目标。
